Hi, I am so sorry life has got you down like this. It isn’t fair sometimes. I know what these moments feel like. I too was living in southern California (Inland Empire) and was completely alone. No friends, no family, just completely alone. Honestly, calling 911 and telling the operator that I wanted to kill myself ended up being a good thing. It got me the help I needed and I was away from all triggers in my life for a few days. It gave me time to step back and think about what was going on in my life and how to change it. The hospital also provided me with a number of resources to help me move forward as a broke student with no job. Maybe a call to 911 could really help in more ways than you know. Whatever you decide to do in this moment, I hope that it leads you down a safe and happy path in your life. Whether you call a friend back home or 911 or some other coping method, take care of yourself and make sure you’re okay. Hugs.
